acceptance_criteria.criterion: On a fresh state (all SETUP_COMPONENTS[].detect() return false), launching the menu displays the redirect message and scope-selection prompt.
handleFirstRun() returns ['global-mcp'] when the user selects the global option.
handleFirstRun() returns ['mcp-json'] when the user selects the workspace-only option.
Pressing q within the 2-second window skips the wizard and presents the normal menu.
node scripts/cli.js --skip-setup-check bypasses the first-run redirect entirely, regardless of detection state.
The cli-menu library receives no scope-decision logic — it only receives the array of component IDs returned by handleFirstRun().

summary: Added async handleFirstRun(): uses readline.createInterface in cooked mode; prompts '[g] Globally (recommended)' and '[w] Workspace-only'; returns ['global-mcp'] (default) or ['mcp-json'].
Added firstRunRedirect: !skipSetupCheck and onFirstRun: handleFirstRun to createMenu() config.
Scope-decision logic entirely within cli.js; cli-menu receives only the ID array. 80 tests pass.

summary: PASS with Fix-Forward. Implementation is clean and correctly scoped — all business logic (scope selection) lives in scripts/cli.js; cli-menu receives only the string[] of component IDs. skipSetupCheck placement, firstRunRedirect wiring, and handleFirstRun() return values are all correct.

Fix-Forward applied: removed redundant 'async' keyword from handleFirstRun(). The function returns new Promise() directly, making 'async' unnecessary and an antipattern; the () => Promise<string[]> contract is still satisfied. 80/80 tests confirmed green post-fix.
Documentation-Forward tagged: --skip-setup-check flag is undocumented in the file-header Usage block.

comments.note: Removed redundant 'async' keyword from handleFirstRun() in scripts/cli.js (line 795). The function body is 'return new Promise(...)' — returning a Promise directly without await makes the 'async' decorator a no-op antipattern. The () => Promise<string[]> contract (types.ts:127) is fully satisfied by the plain function. Non-behavioral; 80/80 tests confirmed green.

[documentation-forward] The --skip-setup-check flag is not listed in the file-header Usage block at the top of scripts/cli.js (lines 6-15). Add an entry such as: 'node scripts/cli.js --skip-setup-check  Skip first-run detection (for CI/automated use)' so the bypass mechanism is discoverable without reading the implementation.

EOF/non-interactive stdin edge case: if stdin is closed before handleFirstRun() reads input, the readline 'question' callback will not fire and the Promise will hang indefinitely. This is acceptable for an interactive tool (CI callers should pass --skip-setup-check), but worth documenting. No blocking concern.
